author: N6rL
content:
## Result

All four Library trait methods implemented for SqliteLibrary:

**resolve_identity** — 5-step cascade: content_hash → DOI → arxiv_id → title_hint LIKE → NewUnique.

**ingest** — ExactMatch guard (LibraryError::IdentityResolution on duplicate hash) + VersionUpdate path (UPDATE existing row + dedup_anchors_index) + NewUnique path (INSERT both tables, transaction-wrapped).

**get** — SELECT + JSON deserialization for all columns. year stored as i64 converted via u32::try_from().ok() (None for corrupt values).

**query** — Dynamic SQL with Vec<SqlValue> params_from_iter. Supports content_type, author (LIKE on JSON array), year_range, text_search, limit.

**library.rs** — Removed IdentityResult::VersionUpdate::incoming (ADR-010). resolve_identity only receives &DeduplicationAnchors so it can never construct a RawDocument<Validated>.

**ADR-010** written.

Tests: 15 unit tests pass (6 new: new_unique_ingest_returns_id, exact_match_by_content_hash, ingest_exact_match_guard_returns_error, version_update_by_doi, soft_match_by_title_hint, get_returns_ingested_object). 11 membrane tests pass. Total: 26/26.

cargo fmt ✓ cargo clippy -D warnings ✓ cargo test ✓

get + query also implemented, so #16 is complete as a side effect.
